The '''Business District''' was a locale on the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tynna/Legends|Tynna]]. It was situated between the [[Tanallay Surge complex]] and [[Water Park]].<ref name="EssGuiPlaMoo" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Business District was introduced in the [[1998]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Planets and Moons]]'', which was written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and illustrated by [[Brandon McKinney]] and [[Scott Kolins]].<ref name="EssGuiPlaMoo" />
